chapters.chapter_title: I Like Riding a Bike on Sunday

questions.text: On which day does the speaker like reading?

audio.text: I like riding my bike on Sunday and reading on Monday.

questions.text: Which day does the speaker prefer for badminton?
questions.discussion: The reply gives Friday as the preferred day.

audio.text: Do you like playing badminton on Saturday? No, I like playing badminton on Friday.

questions.text: When does Ayu’s brother like drawing?
questions.discussion: The next day after Wednesday is Thursday.

audio.text: Ayu likes drawing on Wednesday. Her brother likes drawing the next day.

questions.text: What is the same in both plans?

audio.text: Bima likes singing on Monday. Sari likes swimming on Monday.

questions.text: Which day should you mark for next week?
questions.discussion: Thursday is the day mentioned for next week.

audio.text: Our club meets on Tuesday this week. Next week, we meet on Thursday.
